name: plantA_tpy

name: price_ta
description: Industrial hydrolysable tannin extract. Bounds: spruce-bark tannin MSP 2.1 EUR/kg (2026 TEA-LCA) to pure chestnut tannin 16.6 EUR/kg (food grade, Italy 2024)
source: Sci. Direct chestnut tannin review 2024; PW Consulting 2026 citing TEA-LCA

name: price_co2
description: Purified CO2 purchased from the capture plant at a market price. Base 60 USD/t = mid-point of the USD 40-80/t cost of CO2 capture and purification at coal- and gas-fired power plants (a seller recovers at least this cost); range extends to bulk merchant liquid-CO2 prices (~100-120 USD/t)
source: IEA 2019, Putting CO2 to Use, p. 32 and p. 69

name: price_rcf
